title: MIPI CSI-2 receiver, packet layer on a 1 bit per clock HS lane: SoT sync, header ECC (single-bit correction), short packets (frame start / end), long packets with CRC-16 into a ping-pong line buffer

fields.desc: between a Frame Start and a Frame End
[0] CRC error, [1] uncorrectable header, [2] burst ended inside a packet, [3] header corrected; they accumulate and clear at Frame Start
bytes in the readable line (the last long packet with a good CRC, at most 512)
good long packets since the last Frame Start
word count (long packet) or data field (short packet)
byte of the readable line shown in LB_DATA
byte LB_ADDR of the last good line

irqs.name: ERROR
irqs.desc: a CRC error or an uncorrectable header; the core holds it until the next good packet, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: rx_bit and rx_valid are the lane pins (rx_valid high for one HS burst, one bit per PCLK, LSB first); they pass through unchanged.
The line buffer is double-buffered: a long packet fills the back half and a good CRC swaps the halves, so LB_DATA always reads the last good line. Bytes beyond 512 are checked but not stored.
